name: Blade Ward
description: You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding in the air. Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.
effect: Until the start of your next turn, you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage (take half).
notes: In combat: halves bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage until your next turn.
